test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: An electronic store makes a television set for Rs. 86,500 and allows a discount of 9% in it. What is the selling price (in Rs.) of the television set?
solution:
**Given:**

Price of the television = Rs. 86500

Discount % = 9

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Selling price = 86500 - 86500 × 9%

⇒ 86500 - 7785

⇒ 78715

So, the selling price of the television is Rs. 78715

**∴ The selling price (in Rs.) of the television set is 78715.**
